title: Act 36 of 1963 not to apply for recovery of** **[1][waqf] properties
text:
107. Act 36 of 1963 not to apply for recovery of [waqf] properties.—Nothing contained in the

Limitation Act, 1963 shall apply to any suit for possession of immovable property comprised in any
1[waqf] or for possession of any interest in such property.
